reasons.plan: Adeline tokens and anthems like Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette and Makindi Stampede fit, but well over a fifth of the cards are off-plan (Tsabo's Web, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Haystack, Righteous Avengers, Darksteel Brute, Scroll of Avacyn, Konda).
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable, but 45 lands (43 Plains plus Cactus Preserve and Makindi) is far too many for a curve that peaks at 3 mana.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot and Luck Bobblehead are real ramp, plus the one-shot Golden Egg and the narrow Foundry Inspector.
reasons.draw: There are many small one-shot cantrips (Golden Egg, Tsabo's Web, Fountain of Renewal, Implement of Improvement, Scroll of Avacyn, Novice Inspector, Wrench) and only Loran and Ginger's monarch as repeatable sources.
reasons.interaction: Removal is a handful of clunky pieces (Loran, Molten-Tail Masticore, Arbalest Elite, the 12-mana Tower of Calamities) plus tappers and Worldslayer, with no real board wipe.

details.summary: A bloated mono-white Adeline deck with too many lands and too many filler artifacts; the refine added only two modest removal pieces and left the weakest cards in.

reasons.draw: Many one-shot cantrips (Golden Egg, Tsabo's Web, Implement of Improvement, Scroll of Avacyn, Fountain of Renewal, Novice Inspector, Wrench, Commander's Sphere) keep some flow, but there is no real repeatable engine beyond the narrow Harper Recruiter and Gate to the Afterlife.
reasons.interaction: Real removal is limited to Arbalest Elite, the overcosted Tower of Calamities and the symmetrical Worldslayer, with the rest being tappers (Fiend Binder, Angelic Benediction), protection (Cliffside Rescuer, Haystack) and Hold at Bay.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a Sheoldred sacrifice-and-reanimate Zombie plan (Fleshbag Marauder, Victimize, Midnight Reaper, Vampiric Rites, Gray Merchant), but filler like Liliana's Talent, Render Inert, Grisly Transformation and Grimoire of the Dead dilutes it.
reasons.fit: All ten 6+ drops were cut, and Open the Graves, Curse of Disturbance and Crippling Fear roughly replace Zombie Apocalypse, Army of the Damned and Necromantic Selection, but Liliana's Talent, Render Inert, Ruthless Negotiation, Scorn-Blade Berserker and Grisly Transformation don't do the jobs of Gravespawn Sovereign, Phyrexian Gargantua or Scourge of Nel Toth.
reasons.mana: 33 lands in mono-black with a curve now topping out at 5 (plus the 7-drop commander) is workable given the rocks, with only Uncharted Haven entering tapped.
reasons.ramp: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Thought Vessel, Commander's Sphere, Phyrexian Atlas, Heraldic Banner, Unstable Obelisk, Hedron Archive and Wayfarer's Bauble give about nine pieces, enough to cast Sheoldred on time.
reasons.draw: Repeatable engines like Braids, Arisen Nightmare, Vampiric Rites, Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Spark Reaper and Gibbering Barricade sit alongside one-shots like Phyrexian Rager, Skyscanner and Liliana's Standard Bearer.
reasons.interaction: Plenty of creature removal (Murder, Fell, Cut Down, Deadly Derision, Bone Splinters, Feed the Swarm, Fleshbag Marauder, Syphon Flesh) plus Crippling Fear as a one-sided sweeper and Invasion of Ravnica, though answers to artifacts and enchantments are thin.

reasons.plan: Adeline points toward go-wide aggro with Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Waylay and Worthy Knight, but many cards don't serve that plan, such as Bargain, Tsabo's Web, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Luck Bobblehead, Tower of Calamities and The Dawning Archaic.
reasons.fit: The deck goes from 41 to 37 lands as asked, but only Alpha Myr and Loran of the Third Path are cheap creatures that help Adeline go wide, while Defenestrated Phantom and the near-uncastable 10-mana The Dawning Archaic don't suit her.
reasons.mana: Thirty-seven lands (35 Plains, Cactus Preserve, Makindi Mesas) is a dependable mono-white base for a curve that tops out with ten cards at 6+, with only two tapped lands.

reasons.interaction: Answers are few and clunky: Loran, Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore and Curse of Conformity, with Worldslayer as an awkward reset and only tappers and Haystack or Cliffside Rescuer for protection.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a flyers plan that Kangee pumps, such as Steel-Plume Marshal, Kangee's Lieutenant, Thunderclap Wyvern, Gravitational Shift and Skycat Sovereign, but Lightshell Duo, Whiskervale Forerunner, Felidar Retreat, White Sun's Zenith and Ajani pull away from it.
reasons.fit: Lands go from 26 to 36 with Command Tower, Meandering River and 8 basics, Sol Ring and Arcane Signet are the two ramp additions, and the 12 cuts (Feather of Flight, Mind Spiral, Samite Herbalist, Vow of Duty, Phyrexian Censor and others) are mostly the weakest cards.
reasons.mana: 36 lands suit a curve centred on 2-3, and colours are dependable with Command Tower and many dual lands, though five duals always enter tapped (Coastal Tower, Meandering River, Sejiri Refuge, Temple of Enlightenment, Tranquil Cove) and Moorland Haunt makes only colourless.
reasons.ramp: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Talisman of Progress, Sky Diamond, Commander's Sphere, Hedron Archive and Wayfarer's Bauble make eight pieces, with Warden of Evos Isle and Cartographer's Hawk on top.
reasons.draw: There are well over eight sources, including repeatable engines like Windreader Sphinx, Tide Skimmer, Bident of Thassa, Staggering Insight and Faerie Mastermind alongside Sphinx's Revelation, Winged Words, Deep Analysis and Inspiring Overseer.
reasons.interaction: Six counterspells (Counterspell, Absorb, Sinister Sabotage and others), spot removal like Prayer of Binding, Hanged Executioner, Cut Short and Condemn, the wipes Cleansing Nova and Time Wipe, and protection like Surge of Salvation and Angelic Intervention give broad coverage.

Nonland cards by mana value, before: 1: 4, 2: 12, 3: 18, 4: 11, 5: 9, 6: 3, 7+: 6.
Cut: 1 Army of the Damned, 1 Scourge of Nel Toth
Added: 1 Assimilate Essence, 1 Negate

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a Zombie graveyard-recursion plan around Gisa and Geralf, including Cemetery Reaper, Diregraf Captain, Havengul Lich and Undead Augur, but a handful of non-Zombie value creatures such as Faerie Mastermind, Mind Drill Assailant, Phyrexian Rager and Terror of Towashi dilute the tribal focus.
reasons.fit: It adds exactly two counterspells, Assimilate Essence and Negate, and cuts Army of the Damned (8 mana) and Scourge of Nel Toth (7 mana), two of the most expensive cards, with no other changes.
reasons.mana: 36 lands with a 16 Swamp / 12 Island split plus Command Tower, Choked Estuary and Sunken Hollow suits the curve, though five lands always enter tapped (Dismal Backwater, Jwar Isle Refuge, Salt Marsh, Submerged Boneyard, Temple of Deceit).
reasons.ramp: Seven mana rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Dimir Signet, Talisman of Dominance, Thought Vessel, Commander's Sphere, Hedron Archive) plus Deadly Derision's Treasure are solid but slightly light for four 7-drops.
reasons.draw: There are well over eight draw sources, including repeatable engines like Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Laboratory Drudge, Idol of Oblivion and Faerie Mastermind alongside Pilfered Plans, Deep Analysis and Invasion of Vryn.
reasons.interaction: Spot removal (Cut Down, Fell, Murder, Deadly Derision, Feed the Swarm), five counterspells (Counterspell, Sinister Sabotage, Undermine, Negate, Assimilate Essence), edicts and wipes (Crippling Fear, Necromantic Selection, Necrotic Hex) give flexible answers and board resets.

details.summary: A focused Dimir Zombie recursion deck with abundant draw and interaction, and the refine cleanly makes the requested swap. Its main weaknesses are a few off-plan creatures, some tapped lands and slightly modest ramp for its top end.
